description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions related to pairing file management in a project. It tests functions for resolving file paths, pruning expired pending requests, reconciling pending pairing requests, and ensuring correct functionality through various scenarios using the 'vitest' testing framework.

methods.name: resolvePairingPaths
methods.description: Resolves and constructs file paths for pairing-related files based on a base directory and a subpath.

methods.name: pruneExpiredPending
methods.description: Removes pending requests from an object if they are older than a specified TTL.

methods.name: reconcilePendingPairingRequests
methods.description: Reconciles and updates pending pairing requests based on incoming requests and current state, including refresh logic and persistence.

ctags.name: existing
ctags.pattern: /^    const existing = { requestId: "req-1", deviceId: "device-1", ts: 1, version: 1 };$/
